summary: Open native Mac attention cards instantly beside the inbox with readable conversation and deliberate answer sending

schema.detail: Client-only rendering of existing attention snapshots and timeline excerpts; no schema, codegen, threads or composer changes.

rules.detail: Authoritative attention reread and fenced answer submission are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Cards open in a 760 pt list/detail split with a sticky decision footer. Recommended choices are preselected; selecting only picks, and Send or Command-Return submits. Bare Return never sends. Conversation prompts and reasoning have disclosures, prose is attributed, and GitHub references are shortened. One bounded stale-while-revalidate cache enriches synchronous list snapshots.

recovery.detail: Restore the prior native app package to roll back; daemon state is unchanged.
